speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what are the plans under Healthier SG for younger persons with disabilities; and (b) whether the Ministry is willing to pilot some programmes with major disability social service agencies and healthcare professionals.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: There are specific considerations in delivering care to PwDs and we are committed to working with partners on this journey.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Our healthcare professionals may face challenges, such as when there are high medical and social needs involved which need detailed support.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We will continue to build these capabilities in the community so as to support more caregivers and families of PwDs.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In line with making healthy living more accessible under Healthier SG, we are also working with partners to bring a wider range of programmes and activities closer to all residents, regardless of their level of mobility.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Meeting the health and healthcare needs of PwDs will require coordination of the efforts of different stakeholders.
